lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Halcyon's still moored. Funny how small she looks when you're stuck down here.
lines.direction: wry, glancing toward the docking bay window

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Best air on the whole station in here. Almost smells like rain.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Still gives me the creeps knowing four hundred metres of ocean is one hatch away.
lines.direction: dry blue-collar humour hiding genuine unease

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Real carpet and potted plants. Nice to see where our hazard pay went.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Pressure door hall's torn up. Whatever came through that duct didn't use the latch.
lines.direction: low, rattled, keeping his voice down

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Check the racks, Jay. Take every shell you can carry.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Still cold in here. They cleared out in a hurry.
lines.direction: quiet, hushed observation under his breath

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Dispatch desk is dead. Nobody's answering from topside.
